name: JoAi: Update Automation

description.en: Update name, enabled flag, trigger, or agent of a lifecycle automation. To replace actions use set_automation_actions. To remove permanently with no active enrollments use delete_automation; otherwise disable it.
description.de: Aktualisiert Name, Aktivierungsstatus, Trigger oder Agent einer Automation. Aktionen ersetzt du über set_automation_actions. Permanent löschen (ohne aktive Enrollments): delete_automation — sonst deaktivieren.
description.fr: Met à jour le nom, l'état d'activation, le déclencheur ou l'agent. Pour remplacer les actions, utilisez set_automation_actions. Suppression définitive sans enrollments actifs : delete_automation — sinon désactivez-la.
description.es: Actualiza nombre, estado de activación, trigger o agente. Para sustituir acciones usa set_automation_actions. Borrado permanente sin enrollments activos: delete_automation — si no, desactívala.
description.it: Aggiorna nome, stato di attivazione, trigger o agente. Per sostituire le azioni usa set_automation_actions. Eliminazione permanente senza enrollment attivi: delete_automation — altrimenti disattivala.
description.ro: Actualizează numele, starea de activare, triggerul sau agentul. Pentru acțiuni folosește set_automation_actions. Ștergere permanentă fără enrollment-uri active: delete_automation — altfel dezactiveaz-o.

bot: Pass automationId hashid. To replace actions use set_automation_actions. To disable, set enabled to false. To permanently remove with no active enrollments, use delete_automation.

inputs.name: Enabled
inputs.bot: Set to false to disable; use delete_automation to remove when idle.

inputs.name: Trigger config
inputs.bot: For prop: {"propKey":"…","propValue":"…"}. For segment: {"segmentId":"…"}. For webhook: {"source":"…"}. For site_monthly_report: {}.

inputs.name: Agent ID
inputs.bot: Optional agent UUID (required for webhook triggers / message warps). Pass empty string to clear.

error.fr: Échec de la mise à jour de l'automatisation : {{MESSAGE}}
error.es: No se pudo actualizar la automatización: {{MESSAGE}}
